title: {Syn} DeepSeek-R1 Put Reinforcement Learning in the Reasoning Spotlight
content:
DeepSeek-R1, released in 2025, emphasized reinforcement learning for reasoning behavior in large language models and published technical details about its training recipe.

The paper drew attention because it discussed reasoning-specialized models, distillation, and open model releases in a period of intense competition around test-time reasoning.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
